item.title: How to Buy and Sell Stocks: A Guide for Beginners
item.description: 1 What is a Stock? A stock is a small ownership stake in a company. When you buy shares (股份) of a company, you become one of its owners. For example: A company is divided into 1,000,000 shares. You buy 100 shares. You then own 100/1,000,000, which is 1/10,000, fraction of that company. As an owner, you may benenfit if The company become more valuable. So the fractions (i.e., shares) become more valuable, too.
